limitations: Exact scans cover cases with at most one million cumulative count states; larger representative cases retain E94/E93 analytic certificates.
Point checks are omitted when a single sample size exceeds one million multinomial count states.
The exact probabilities are conditional on fixed E83 path-risk estimates and the declared categorical prevalence model.
The audit covers E92's 192 representative cases rather than the full prevalence/accuracy/tolerance grid.
The audit is local statistical analysis and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Enumerate all multinomial count vectors for tractable representative E94 cases, apply the full lexicographic policy selector, and sum exact count probabilities. Scanned cases report the first sample after the last exact failure above 5%; E94 guarantees all later sample sizes.
